findings.title: Termination for Convenience Notice Period
findings.rationale: The evidence specifies the notice period required for termination of the agreement without cause.
evidence_excerpts: Either party may terminate the Agreement by providing 60 days written notice to the other party.

findings.title: Governing Law and Dispute Resolution
findings.rationale: The evidence explicitly outlines the process for dispute resolution and mentions arbitration as the method to resolve disputes, along with the governing law reference.
evidence_excerpts: Any dispute arising from this Agreement shall first be addressed through amicable discussions between the parties. If unresolved, the matter shall be referred to arbitration under the Indian Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996.
